page_title: Shimo - The VPN client for Mac. No borders. No limits. Just connect.

summary.name: Shimo
summary.one_liner: Shimo is a macOS menu bar VPN client that connects to many VPN protocols, including OpenVPN, WireGuard, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet, and IPsec.
use_cases: Connecting to an employer's VPN from a Mac
Managing many VPN accounts in one app
Automatically connecting VPN based on Wi-Fi or location
Tracking VPN connection time and data for billing
Deploying preconfigured VPN accounts to users
Using RSA SecurID or token-based two-factor VPN login
summary.what_it_does:
Shimo is a VPN client for macOS that runs from the menu bar and supports protocols including WireGuard, Amnezia, OpenVPN, IPsec (IKEv1), Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet SSL VPN, Palo Alto GlobalProtect, Pulse Secure/Ivanti, and SSH with port forwarding. It can hold multiple simultaneous connections and organize accounts into groups. Credentials and certificates are stored in the macOS Keychain, and it supports XAUTH and token-based two-factor authentication. Automation can connect accounts based on network configuration, location, Wi-Fi, or launched applications, and it records time stamps, duration, IP address, and traffic for CSV export. IT administrators can create deployment packages with optional read-only account settings.</what_it_does>
